SddInterviewProtocol.keywords: interview, coverage-map, triage, amplification, rounds, defaults-first, weak-spots, closure, sdd-interview-protocol
SddInterviewProtocol.Mission:
Run ONE operator interview for an authoring step. Loaded lazily by a branch step (scope STEP_2 / STEP_3, infra STEP_2, interface STEP_2, module STEP_2) via `READ_AND_USE_DIRECTIVE`; the calling step supplies the scope-type + its focus and stays the owner of what gets written. Inherits the router core (language, dialogue, safeguard, diverge, no-narration) — not repeated here.
This protocol equips the interview declared by `AX_OPERATOR_SAFEGUARD` with instruments: a live coverage map, an amplification triage, defaults-first rounds, and a map-based closure criterion. The safeguard axiom stays the source of the interviewing instinct; this directive only gives it structure.
Input — scope-type, calling-step focus, intake gathered so far. Output — a closed coverage map + the captured answers and decisions, returned to the calling step. This directive writes no artifact; control returns to the caller at CLOSE.

BeliefState.Axiom: The interview ends when the coverage map is closed — every topic `[✔]` or explicitly skipped with a recorded reason — never when a question count is reached, and never by a silent Approval Check. After every operator answer, re-check the map: an answer that opens a new hole or risk adds a topic or reopens a closed one (thread-pulling per `AX_OPERATOR_SAFEGUARD` — that axiom owns the instinct; this one binds it to the map). A skip on a high-stakes topic goes through `H_HIGH_STAKES_SKIP`.

Where a defensible default exists, lead with it: propose one concrete option drawn from real production practice and ask the operator to confirm or correct — instead of an open question. The default MUST be the result of `AX_DIVERGE_BEFORE_RECOMMEND`, not the first typical answer. Reserve open questions for decisions that are genuinely operator-owned (business goals, risk acceptance, priorities) or where no defensible default exists; open-ended deepening on any topic happens when the operator asks for it.

Amplifications are opt-in: after triage the agent PROPOSES a set from the catalog, the operator confirms; the default for small tasks is «none active». State an empty proposal explicitly — «усиления не нужны, потому что …» — it is a valid triage outcome, not a silent omission. A confirmed amplification becomes a map topic and its directive loads lazily via `READ_AND_USE_DIRECTIVE` at the moment its topic opens, never up front.

SddInterviewProtocol.TopicCatalog:
Base topics — every interview starts with these (map labels in Russian):
| Topic | Substance | |---|---| | Цель и не-цель | what this scope delivers; what it explicitly refuses to do in this iteration | | Потребители | who consumes the result and what they expect from it | | Слабые места | MANDATORY: holes, contradictions, unstated expectations of the intake — name them to the operator, per `AX_OPERATOR_SAFEGUARD` | | Внешние зависимости | what outside this scope must exist / hold for the design to stand |
scope-type block — append per the caller's scope-type:
| scope-type | Topics | |---|---| | product | Пользователи (who exactly, how many) · Метрика успеха/провала (both, not only success) · Зачем сейчас (why this, why now) · Worst case (the worst plausible scenario and who pays for it) | | library | Разработчики-потребители (which teams / repos) · DX (how consumption should feel; feeds Golden DX) · Версии (versioning + compatibility promises) | | infrastructure | Окружения (dev / CI / prod parity) · Доставка (how changes reach consumers) | | interface | Стороны контракта (producers and consumers, who owns the schema) · Эволюция (how the contract changes without breaking consumers) |
The calling step MAY narrow or extend the block for its focus (e.g. scope STEP_3 keeps only what the Requirements Gate still misses); «Слабые места» stays on every map.
SddInterviewProtocol.AmplificationCatalog:
Deep-dive modules; each is a separate directive authored elsewhere and loaded lazily (`AX_AMPLIFICATION_OPT_IN`):
| Amplification | Directive | Triage trigger | |---|---|---| | security | `ai/directives/sdd-v2/amplify-security.directive.xml` | external users, or data crossing a trust boundary | | nfr | `ai/directives/sdd-v2/amplify-nfr.directive.xml` | load / latency / volume significant enough to shape the design | | storage | `ai/directives/sdd-v2/amplify-storage.directive.xml` | state persisted beyond a single run | | observability | `ai/directives/sdd-v2/amplify-observability.directive.xml` | someone must diagnose this in production |
SddInterviewProtocol.HaltConditions: | 🛑 ID | Trigger | |---|---| | `H_HIGH_STAKES_SKIP` | Operator insists on skipping an unclosed high-stakes topic — name the concrete cost (per `AX_OPERATOR_SAFEGUARD`); on a confirmed skip record `[✗ skip: <причина>]` in the map and proceed |

Step.Goal: Build and show the coverage map.
Step.Action: Assemble the map: base topics + the scope-type block from `TopicCatalog`, narrowed / extended by the calling step's focus. Mark topics the intake already answers `[✔]` — ask only what a decision still needs. Render per `COVERAGE_MAP_FORMAT` with a one-line plan («что осталось закрыть»); proceed straight to triage.

Step.Goal: Decide which amplifications this task deserves.
Step.Action: One compact block of 3–5 closed questions (yes / no / short pick), mandatory even when the task looks small: external users or external data? load significant? state persisted? must this be diagnosable in production? — plus at most one triage question specific to the intake. From the answers, propose an amplification set per `AmplificationCatalog` with the small-task default «none active» (`AX_AMPLIFICATION_OPT_IN`); operator confirms. Confirmed amplifications become map topics on the «Усиления» line. STOP.

Step.Goal: Close the map topic by topic.
Step.Action: Loop until the map is closed (`AX_COVERAGE_MAP_CLOSURE`); each round: 1. Show the map per `COVERAGE_MAP_FORMAT`, pick 1–2 open topics, mark them `[▶]`. 2. Ask the round as ONE grouped call: `AskUserQuestion` / `MultiAsk` with concrete options + «Other» when the tool is available; otherwise `QUESTION_FORMAT` (`Q`). 3. Shape each question per `AX_DEFAULTS_FIRST` — a concrete default to confirm or correct; stakes gate the presentation per `AX_DIALOGUE_DISCIPLINE`. 4. After each answer, update the map and pull the thread per `AX_COVERAGE_MAP_CLOSURE` (new hole → new / reopened topic). 5. An amplification topic opens → `READ_AND_USE_DIRECTIVE` its directive from `AmplificationCatalog` and run its questions as this round. A skip request on a high-stakes topic → `H_HIGH_STAKES_SKIP`.

Step.Goal: Verify closure and return to the caller.
Step.Action: Gate per `AX_COVERAGE_MAP_CLOSURE`: every topic `[✔]` or `[✗ skip: <причина>]` — an open or `[▶]` topic sends the flow back to STEP_3. Show the final map + a compact digest of answers and decisions (Russian), including skips with reasons. Hand the digest to the calling step — it owns the Approval Check, artifact writing, and any Decision Log entries.

SddInterviewProtocol.ChatOutput:
The map per `COVERAGE_MAP_FORMAT` opens every round — it is the operator's progress view, so keep it current and compact (per `AX_NO_PROCESS_NARRATION`, the map replaces narration about what the interview is doing).
Live coverage map, shown to the operator compactly before every round. Topic labels in Russian; ≤ 72 columns; statuses: `[✔]` closed · `[▶]` in progress · `[ ]` open · `[✗ skip: <причина>]`.
Покрытие: Цель/не-цель [✔] · Потребители [▶] · Слабые места [ ] · Зависимости [ ] Усиления: security [▶] · storage [✗ skip: прототип, данных нет]
4–6 topics per line; the «Усиления» line appears only when at least one amplification is active or skipped. The map is session state for the dialogue — the calling step decides what from the answers lands in the artifact; the map itself stays out of the spec.
